column1: # /ati "t" (track kind), /sti "t", the default colour index per track kind, and the nc and p columns of /ati (scopes ati.nc and ati.p). Logic 12.3.1 (6682), Logic.arm64 sha256=2f141e1a1f7b90a4fb0205ffec3dbe187baf601d20e9acb398acfadcdf050998.
# Source: SA-REMOTE-TRACKTYPE-001 (static), EXP-REMOTE-001 and EXP-REMOTE-003 (one reception each, 2026-10-05). live_check: observed = seen in the named reception; unconfirmed = not seen.
# The condition column is read from the code (anchors name the rows of logic-remote-trackcolor-anchors.tsv that pin the constants).
# The meaning column is a hypothesis with the stated confidence unless live_check says observed; even then it rests on one project.
# For scope ati.t the rule number is the order in which trackTypeForTrack:seqID:ginst:inSong: (0x01693e90) tries the rules; the first that applies wins.
# Terms: G = the "ginst object" FUN_01a15c7c(song, ginst) returns (only for a strip whose type byte +0x69 is 0x11), kind(G) = ushort at G[0] with bit 3 cleared;
#        entry = the 0x50-byte track entry (kind byte +0x10, depth byte +0x12, flags +0x14, id +0x20); strip type = byte +0x69 of the strip the entry's id selects.

column4: entry known and FUN_019fa680 is true (entry kind not 3, 4, 5, 0xc; the next entry that is not kind 5 or 0xc is exactly one level deeper) and entry[+0x14] & 0x40
column6: a track whose entry has children with flag 0x40 (R1). Seen once: Amped Up (gindex 132) in EXP-REMOTE-003, whose /sti t was 2, so its strip kind word is 0x43 (software instrument): a software-instrument track with child tracks, stack-like. What Logic calls it (summing stack or other) is unconfirmed
